project.name: Two-Phase Commit
project.description: Bank transfer with a coordinator (node-1 = TM) and resource managers (node-2 ... node-N = RMs), each holding 100. The TM sends Prepare to every RM, commits only on a YES from everyone (one NO aborts), writes commit/abort to its log before notifying, and after a crash resumes from that log: no decision is presumed abort, a commit decision is resent until every RM acknowledges.
